summary: Options for the default callback: check_mode_markers, display_failed_stderr, display_included_hosts, display_ok_hosts, display_skipped_hosts, and pretty_results, which prettifies output but may alter YAML results.
questions: How do I hide skipped tasks in ansible-playbook output?
How do I hide ok results and only show changes?
How do I send failed task output to stderr?
How do I show DRY RUN markers in check mode?
How do I make ansible-playbook output more readable?

answer_card.title: default callback display options
answer_card.answer_md:
- `check_mode_markers` (default false): show `DRY RUN` at start/end and `CHECK MODE` on each play/task under `--check`.
- `display_failed_stderr` (default false): send failed/unreachable results to STDERR.
- `display_included_hosts` (default true, 2.21+): show included task/host results.
- `display_ok_hosts` (default true): show `ok` results.
- `display_skipped_hosts` (default true): show skipped results.
- `pretty_results` (2.13+): always pretty-print results. Defaults true for `yaml` format, false for `json`. With YAML it may alter output for readability, so don't rely on it for writing conditionals.
